about: VSRG Hub update feed: the newest version and what is new. Read by the VSRG Hub launcher.
notes: - On a profile, the legend under the plays (Etterna, osu!, Quaver) is the per-game filter: hover shows it can be pressed, press one for that game's best plays by SSR, again for all. osu!lazer plays count as osu! (no separate colour).

latest.notes: - On a profile, the legend under the plays (Etterna, osu!, Quaver) is the per-game filter: hover shows it can be pressed, press one for that game's best plays by SSR, again for all. osu!lazer plays count as osu! (no separate colour).

changelog.notes: - On a profile, the legend under the plays (Etterna, osu!, Quaver) is the per-game filter: hover shows it can be pressed, press one for that game's best plays by SSR, again for all. osu!lazer plays count as osu! (no separate colour).
- Scrolling the song list past the picked song no longer reloads its ranking board or makes its picture blink: the board and the picture stay when the chart is the same one.

- **Rankings on the web:** rankings, profiles (with pins, pictures and the rating graph), each chart's top, and a page to compare two players, at https://naidez7.github.io/vsrghub/rankings.html (once the site is turned on). Share a profile by link.
- **Best plays per game:** on a profile, Best 4K / 7K can be narrowed to Etterna, osu!, lazer or Quaver plays.
- **Results screen:** after a play, your place on that chart too.
- **"Someone passed you":** when song select comes up and your 4K or 7K place dropped since last time, the game says so.
- **Sending plays no longer gets stuck** on "statement timeout": the server checks replays much faster and the launcher sends smaller batches (and smaller still if the server is slow).
- **Quaver dates** are read from the replay's own clock; plays sent with the wrong date get their real one the next time you press "Send my osu! / Quaver plays again".
- The launcher says when the server is behind (its v2.sql needs running) instead of failing quietly, and the server caps how many scores one player can send in ten minutes.
- "Latest plays" shows again (the pinned plays gave the server a second path between plays and players, and the list asked for an ambiguous one).
- The launcher updates itself even when the copy left by its last update is still held by Windows (it moves aside under a fresh name, and the leftovers are cleared next time).

- Quaver replays are found and read now (they're in Quaver's Data\r, and their file layout differs between Quaver versions: tried against real ones).
- The Play page's stage stays yours once you've pressed a key, until you come back to the page: handing it back to itself mid-play left notes stuck under the receptors.
- Your pinned plays can be dragged into the order you like (on your own profile, "Pinned" tab).

- **Your Quaver plays count too:** "Send my osu! / Quaver plays" reads Quaver's replays as well (a cyan dot on those plays).
- **Pinned plays.** Open one of your plays (click it), press **Pin** on your row, and it shows on your profile under a "Pinned" tab (up to 20).
- **Profile pictures can move:** a GIF is shown as it is (up to 1 MB); a PNG keeps its transparent parts.
- **7K ratings:** Etterna's calculator doesn't rate Technical for 7K (every 7K chart got 0.18), so the 7K overall is now the mean of the six skillsets it does rate, and Technical isn't shown for 7K.
- osu! plays sent before the last server update showed as Etterna's: they're told apart again.
- Rating your osu! / Quaver plays in the game goes on from where it was if you leave song select half way.
- The Play page's arrows can be played: the keyboard arrows hit them, with a combo and judgements. Leave the keys for a few seconds and it plays itself again.

- Profiles with 4K, 7K and the graph no longer run out of the window: each side scrolls on its own.
- The osu!lazer dot is gold (the ring on the pink one was too small to see).

- **Your osu! plays count.** "Send my osu! plays" on the Online page reads your osu! stable replays (and osu!lazer's, for maps that are also in your osu! Songs folder), judges each as Etterna would on the same chart, and the game rates them with Etterna's calculator: every 4K and 7K map is ranked.
- A dot by each play says where it was played: Etterna (violet), osu! (pink) or osu!lazer (pink with a gold ring).
- Song select: the last song's picture stays while the list sits on a pack's name, so the next song's picture fades in over it instead of coming up from black.

- **Profile pictures.** Click your picture on the Online page to pick one (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP): it shows on the rankings, your profile and the latest plays.
- **Latest plays** on the Online page: what everyone played lately. Click a play for that chart's top, or the name for the player.
- **A chart's top.** Click any play on a profile to see each player's best on that chart.
- **Rating over time** on each profile: how the 4K and 7K rating grew, day by day.
- **Report a problem** (the launcher's corner): puts the game's and VSRG Hub's logs in a zip on your desktop, to send with what happened.
- **"A new VSRG Hub is out"** on the game's main menu when there is one.
- **Multiplayer sign-in works:** the EtternaOnline name and password are asked in VSRG Hub's own box (Etterna's took no typing under these looks).
- **Quaver look:** the mouse wheel scrolls the map list without picking each map it passes, as in Quaver; a click picks.
- **osu! look:** closing a pack no longer leaves the old song's difficulties showing over the packs while scrolling.
- The "What's new" timeline: the line starts at the newest version and stops at the last one of each era, with the circles on it.
- Profiles show the right place: everyone read one place too low (#2 for the first).

- Starting a song no longer hangs on "Press Enter again for player options" for several seconds (the player card's refresh held song select open).
- The main menu's circle no longer stays see-through, or vanishes, when clicked while it's still fading in.

- The main menu's circle takes clicks right away (it waited a few seconds after the menu came up).
- Profiles show only the key counts the player has plays in (no empty 7K box for a 4K player).
- Plays no longer show as "not ranked" while the server hasn't been updated for replays yet.

- **Checked scores.** Each play is sent with its replay, and the server works its accuracy out again: a score that doesn't add up isn't ranked.
- **Your older plays.** "Send my older plays" on the Online page puts the plays you made before having an account on the rankings.
- **Rating on results.** The results screen shows how your VSRG Hub rating and place changed with that play.
- **Your rating in the corner.** Signed in, the player card in song select shows your VSRG Hub rating and place.
- **VSRG Hub boards in the lazer and Quaver looks** too, beside Local and EtternaOnline.
- **Forgot your password?** The mail's link now opens a page to choose a new one.
- Clearer message when the server can't send more sign-up mails for now.
- Judgement art set only in another key count's [Mania] section of skin.ini is used too (OFF SCRIPT's results).

- **Player profiles.** Click anyone on the Online page's rankings (or your own name) to open their profile: their place in 4K and 7K, their rating by pattern, their best plays (4K and 7K) and their latest ones, with the rate, MSD, judgements and accuracy of each.
- **Check for updates**: a button in the launcher's corner, above the version, to look for a new version right away.

- **Online page: plays waiting to be sent.** When some of your plays haven't reached VSRG Hub's ranking yet, the Online page says how many and why (not signed in, no player name, no internet...), with a **Send now** button. The launcher's log also says whether you're signed in when the game starts and why plays wait.

- **VSRG Hub online: accounts and rankings.** A new **Online** page in the launcher: make a VSRG Hub account (e-mail and password) and pick your player name, sign in, and see the rankings, 4K and 7K, overall or by pattern (stream, jumpstream, handstream, stamina, jackspeed, chordjack, technical).
- **Every chart is ranked.** While you're signed in, each play you finish is sent to VSRG Hub's rankings (valid for Etterna's rating, not failed, not autoplay or practice), whatever game or pack the chart came from. Your rating is worked out exactly as Etterna works out its own, from your best scores, 4K and 7K apart; the Online page shows it with each pattern's.
- **Plays from before you signed in count too**: the ones played since this version are kept and sent once you sign in.
- **Song select (osu! look): Global Ranking (VSRG Hub)**: the ranking box now goes Local Ranking, VSRG Hub's global ranking for the chart, EtternaOnline's, and the map preview.

- **The launcher says what's missing instead of doing nothing** on PCs without the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (some Windows 10 PCs): it offers to open Microsoft's free download page. Before, the launcher just closed without a word on those PCs when VSRG Hub wasn't installed yet.

- **Fixed: the launcher kept asking to update and wouldn't let you play** after updating to beta.35 or beta.36: those versions still said they were beta.34, so the launcher always saw Etterna's VSRG Hub as a different version. Updating once more (to this version) ends it.

- **Fixed: the launcher said a new version was out but showed no Update button** when Etterna had an older VSRG Hub that doesn't say which version it is (beta.20 and earlier). The Update button now always shows when there's a newer version, and the big button says UPDATE whenever Etterna's VSRG Hub isn't the launcher's version.

- **The osu! look is now osu! stable**, compared screen by screen with osu! itself using the same skins.
- **Main menu like osu! stable**: the big cookie, which grows under the mouse and pulses to the beat, and the purple Play / Options / Exit buttons sliding out of it.
- **Song select like osu! stable**: song panels drawn at your skin's own size, on osu!'s curve, with the song's picture; each difficulty is its own panel with its stars, grade and key count. The mouse wheel scrolls the list freely and the song you picked stays picked until you click another, as in osu!.
- **The top bar as osu! draws it**: your skin's art, the Group / Sort lists, the quick tabs (in crimson, the one in use white), "Search:" and "N matches found!", at osu!'s places and sizes, layered as osu! layers them, so skins that draw their own tabs, hearts or diamonds look as they do in osu!.
- **osu!'s font**: the look now writes in Ubuntu, the free font closest to osu!'s Aller, with fixed letter spacing.
- **Your player card as in osu!**: name, Performance (your Etterna rating), Accuracy (your best scores, weighted as osu! does) and level, where skins leave room for them.
- **Mod select like osu! stable**: the whole screen darkened, a row for each kind of mod, your skin's mod icons, osu!-style icons for the mods your skin has none for, and the big Reset / Close buttons.
- **Results like osu! stable**: your skin's ranking panel, title, back button and replay button, osu!'s 7-digit score and the hit counts at osu!'s places.
- **Ctrl+O opens the options while you're typing a search**, as in osu!.
- **Fixed: every song panel was drawn three or four times over itself**, which made hovering a panel show a copy left behind and made the list slower, in every look.
- **Updates now come from GitHub** (github.com/Naidez7/vsrghub): the launcher checks there for new versions of VSRG Hub and of itself.

- **A new launcher.** Play, Games, What's new and Options, in VSRG Hub's violet and pink. It runs from anywhere: the first time, it puts itself where you choose (with a desktop and Start menu shortcut), finds Etterna (or asks where it is, with a link to get it), and installs VSRG Hub into Etterna with one click. From then on it updates VSRG Hub, and itself, when a new version is out.
- **Your games, at a glance**: Etterna, osu!, Quaver and Qwilight in colour when they're found and grey when they aren't, each with its folder; pick or change any of them, or stop using one.
- **What's new**: every version's notes, from TriWheel's first ones to this, newest first.
- **Options before playing**: resolution, fullscreen / borderless / windowed, refresh rate, VSync, frame limits (menus and gameplay), Direct3D or OpenGL, and Etterna's FPS counter.
- **Fixed: song select stuttered and froze when scrolling fast through many songs** (a long spin of the mouse wheel), in every look. Each song panel asked Etterna for its charts' key count in a way that unpacks every chart's notes, again on every step of the list; the song's background picture was also loaded for every song passed. Now the key count comes from the chart's type, the background waits until the list stops, and panels skip redrawing what hasn't changed.
- **Song select: the difficulties scroll like the songs.** The picked difficulty sits in the middle of the list and the mouse wheel goes through a song's difficulties (gliding), then on to the next or previous song; a quick spin of the wheel keeps going through the songs. Rows that pass the play button keep their MSD clear of it.
- **The osu! look's difficulty rows use your skin's song panel art** (its top and bottom, not squashed), the picked one bright and the others dimmer, with the skin's text colours; skins without panel art keep the blue and white rows.
- **Only 4K and 7K charts**: Etterna's 8K (dance-double), 6K and 3K charts are left out of the difficulty lists, and songs that only have those are left out of the song list (VSRG Hub has no notes or skins for them).

- **The icon is the same picture everywhere**: the window, the taskbar, the desktop shortcut and the launcher all show the four arrow lanes (the small sizes were simpler pictures before). The launcher also tells Windows to redraw the desktop shortcut's picture when the icon changes.
- **Fixed: F3 / F4 (and Options > Scroll speed) got stuck between two speeds** (29 and 30, say): a step landed a hair under its number, so the next one went back to it.

- **F3 / F4 change the scroll speed while playing** (the osu!, osu!lazer and Quaver looks), as in osu! and Quaver: in the song's first seconds (the first 5 seconds, or until just before the first note when the intro is longer). A press is one step; held, it keeps going, faster the longer it's held. The new speed shows at the top of the screen. The keys can be changed in Keybinds.
- **Scroll speed in your game's numbers**: Etterna's C speed is shown and changed as osu!'s scroll speed in the osu! look (27 = C886), osu!lazer's in the lazer look (with its time on screen) and Quaver's in the Quaver look (29.9 = C877), worked out from how fast each game moves its notes. Options > Scroll speed steps by one of them, and takes them typed (27, 30.2) as well as C700, M650 or 2.5x. In osu!lazer and Quaver, Ctrl with F3 / F4 steps by a tenth.

- **A new icon**: Etterna's four arrow lanes, arrows falling onto their receptors, on the violet-to-pink tile (the program, the desktop shortcut, the launcher and the game's window).
- **The launcher's background**: arrows (left, down, up, right) falling onto their receptors, which light up as they're hit and glow while a hold runs into them. A hold's body no longer shows inside its arrow.
- **Customize gameplay: Note width and Note height** (in every look, with Note size): the notes and hold heads stretched across or along their column; hold bodies follow the width. For VSRG Hub's noteskins (made from your osu! and Quaver skins), like Note size.

- **Menus as smooth as your monitor**: Etterna ran the themes' moving parts only 60 times a second, whatever the frame rate, so the pointer, the song list, the logo's visualizer and the beat in the menus moved at 60 per second even on a 200 Hz monitor. They now move every frame (the pointer and the list) or at your monitor's rate (the visualizer and other redrawn shapes), and those shapes are drawn with far less work.
- **The beat**: the logo and the song select's play button now pulse right on the music's beat (they were up to a sixtieth of a second late).
- **Fixed: shapes that got smaller could leave bits of their old shape drawn** (the logo's drifting triangles, some panels).

- **Sharper osu! and osu!lazer looks**: circles, rounded boxes, triangles and lines are drawn with a soft one-pixel edge (no more jagged or blurry edges): the logo, its visualizer (now joined to the logo all the way round), buttons, panels, the results ring and graphs. The "VSRG Hub" word on the logo is redrawn, small text has its own small fonts and big numbers their own big ones, and small icons their own small pictures.
- **Smoother song select**: the song list now glides when you scroll (things moving inside the panels used to freeze it, so it jumped), the panels slide in when you come in, each song's picture fades in over the last one instead of the screen going dark, and the screens fade in and out smoothly.
- **The osu! look's song panels** use your skin's panel art, with each song's picture on it (they showed none), and the skin's lit bottom buttons fade in under the mouse. The results' score, counts, combo and accuracy count up.
- **osu!lazer look**: the difficulty pills show only the MSD (no star); the main menu's side flashes on the beat are soft.
- **First start**: the cursor, combo and interface skins start on the osu! skin you use in osu!, 4K notes on the noteskin Etterna is using, 7K notes on your osu! skin's.
- **Fixed: the osu! look's Play / Options / Exit only took clicks on their right half.**
- **Fixed: switching looks from the main menu changed your 4K notes to DivideByZero.**
- **Fixed: the launcher's background could put a note inside a long note.**
- "Press Enter again for player options" (when Til' Death's hint is on) is a VSRG Hub pill instead of Til' Death's purple bar.

- **New look: osu!lazer** (the fifth look, in the launcher and in Options > Theme). lazer's toolbar (settings, home, 4K / 7K, packs, collections, music controls, your profile, the clock), the main menu's button bar through the logo, song select with lazer's slanted song info, star pills, slanted score rows with grade tabs, search with its match count, Sort / Group / Collection, the carousel with each song's picture, the footer and lazer's mod select; lazer's dialogs; and lazer's results card with the accuracy ring next to the life graph, details and hit offsets. Every feature of the osu! look is there.
- **The osu! look, redesigned**: rounded, coloured and animated like osu!. The main menu's cookie pulses to the menu music (a random song, with previous / pause / next), with its visualizer and the background moving with the mouse; coloured Play / Options / Exit buttons; song panels with the MSD on a pill; rounded dropdowns, tabs, search and ranking rows; the options, lists, dialogs and mods panel restyled; the results with coloured judgement chips, a filled life graph, a "full combo" pill and the pink back tab.
- **Fixed: a crash after opening an online score whose replay EtternaOnline couldn't send** (it played an empty replay, and the next song could crash the game). Now it says so instead.
- **Fixed: coming back from a replay could keep the replay's noteskin** as your pick.
- **Fixed: switching looks could put the osu! skin's notes back** over the notes you picked, on the day you changed skins in osu!.

- **Launcher**: opening vsrghub.exe (or the new "VSRG Hub" desktop shortcut) shows a window with Play, the look to start in and update checks. Started from Melty, the game starts straight away as before.
- **Online rankings** in the osu! and Quaver song select: the ranking box switches between Local and Global (EtternaOnline's leaderboard for the chart). Click an online score to see it, right click to watch its replay.
- **Song select background options**: Background dim and Background blur in the options (osu! and Quaver looks).
- **Sharper text**: the osu! look's fonts are redrawn at a higher resolution, with extra-sharp copies for big numbers (profile rating, scores); the Quaver look and the profile page in Til' Death / Rebirth too.
- **Icon** for vsrghub.exe, the launcher and the game window.
- **Fixed: grades on the song wheel and next to the difficulties** now follow your accuracy on the timing you played (an S stays an S).
- **Fixed: osu! options** — the E (ETTERNA) section can be scrolled to again, and its icon no longer jumps to Keybinds.
- **Fixed: Ctrl+O (and typing) not working in Til' Death and Rebirth** after having been in the osu! or Quaver look in the same session: the other look's key handling stayed active after switching.

- **Song select's scoreboard (osu! and Quaver looks)** shows each score as the results do: its grade and accuracy on the timing it was played on (osu! OD or Etterna judge), with the timing and Etterna's grade (AAAA, AA...) beside it.

- **Results (osu! and Quaver looks):** the big grade now goes by the accuracy on the timing you played with: osu!'s letters in the osu! look (SS 100%, S 95, A 90, B 80, C 70), Quaver's in the Quaver look (X 100%, SS 99, S 95...). 97% on OD 8 is an S. Etterna's grade (AAAA, AA...) is written small next to the J4 accuracy.
- **Combo skin** is now the osu! and Quaver looks' only: Til' Death and Rebirth keep their own combo (the skin digits overlapped it there).

- **Log in to EtternaOnline from any look.** Log in / Log out on the profile page, in the options (EtternaOnline row), in VSRG Hub's Ctrl+O menu in Til' Death and Rebirth, and from Rebirth's login corner (it used to just open the profile). Name or e-mail and password, Ctrl+V pastes. The session is remembered, so the next start logs in by itself in every look; Log out forgets it.

- **Easy updates.** Your songs, settings and layouts now live in Etterna's `Save/VSRGHub` (moved there on the first start), so a new VSRGHub folder never converts your library again. To update: drop the new zip on `vsrghub.exe`, or leave it in Downloads / Desktop and start the game, which asks to install it. (From an older version, extract this one over the old folder once.)
- **Profile: Local / Online.** Online shows your EtternaOnline profile (ratings, world and country rank, and top, recent and most played from all your online scores), and a **Rankings** tab with the world's and your country's players: click one to open their profile, or type a name and press Enter.
- **Customize gameplay, in every look:** a Lighting tab (hit lighting / LightingN, hold lighting / LightingL, column lighting: on or off, moved, sized, width and height), receptors over or under the notes, the lane cover's border (none, line, fade or glow, height and colour; no more grey line), and the **FPS counter** as a HUD part (moved, sized, switched off, each line shown or hidden).
- **Combo skin:** the combo in any skin's digits (osu! or Quaver skins), picked with a preview, in all four looks.
- **Quaver's custom judgement windows:** Quaver's dialog with Peaceful to Impossible and your own (create, name, sliders). Etterna judges on them; Wife% stays J4; the accuracy shown is Quaver's.
- **Til' Death and Rebirth Ctrl+O** has what the osu! look's options have, in sections: noteskin with a live preview, combo skin and pointer with previews, scroll speed and direction, timing (judge, OD or Quaver windows), 7K thumb, Customize gameplay, video / performance / audio, Etterna's options.
- **Quaver look:** skin lists in Quaver's style with the noteskin preview; Quaver skins' stage borders; the lobby chat no longer pops up after a song.
- **Results:** the big accuracy is on the timing you played with (a fail shows the accuracy of what was played), J4 small, other judges in the tooltip.
- **Song select:** search waits until you stop typing and the results slide in; difficulties stay put when you click one; the list no longer wraps round when there are few songs.
- A fail with nothing hit now says so (Etterna keeps no score of it, so it looked like nothing happened).

- **Rate edits are found by the song's name.** A map set with one song at several rates, each with its own audio (e.g. DEVILS NEVER CRY at 0.9, 0.95, 1.05...), used to show each rate titled only by its difficulty ("0.9"), so searching for the song found nothing in Til' Death and Rebirth. Each one is now "DEVILS NEVER CRY [0.9]" and so on, in every look; dan packs keep the pack's name first too. Packs whose difficulties are named "Artist - Title" keep those names. Only those sets are read again on the next start, and your scores stay with them.

- **osu!, Quaver and Qwilight are found on any drive.** osu! (stable) is looked for where Windows says osu!.exe is (osu!'s installer registers it), in its usual folder, and in an osu! folder at the top of any drive, in Games or in Program Files. Quaver and Qwilight are looked for in every Steam library, with Steam itself found wherever it was installed. If one is still missed, `vsrghub.exe --osu "<folder>"` (or `--quaver`, `--qwilight`) points to it, and the log says when only osu!lazer is there (its maps can't be read).

- **The combo shows with skins that put it off the screen.** Some osu! skins set ComboPosition below the screen (nego_dnik edit has 1111), which hides the combo. VSRG Hub now shows it at osu!'s usual place, in the skin's own combo digits; it can still be switched off or moved in Customize gameplay (HUD).

- **Your profile page, in every look.** Click your player card (osu!), PROFILE (Quaver), your profile corner on song select (Til' Death bottom left, Rebirth top left) or Profile in the Ctrl+O menu. A full page in the look's own style, like osu!'s user page with Etterna's numbers: avatar, play time, arrows hit, EtternaOnline rating and rank, your 4K and 7K ratings. Tabs for Overview (a bar for each skillset, grades, plays, charts played, average accuracy, best play, 4K / 7K / total play time, sessions, last plays), Top plays (ranked by SSR, or by one skillset with the chips beside the tabs), Recent plays and Most played, each row with the song's banner, title, artist, difficulty, MSD at the rate, rate, accuracy, grade, SSR and when.
- **Every difficulty of a song in the osu! and Quaver looks.** The selected song opens up as in osu!lazer and Quaver and lists all its charts (name, keys, length, notes, main pattern, MSD at your rate, your best). Click one to pick it, click again to play; the arrows go through them (osu!: up / down, Quaver: left / right) and on to the next song.
- No more "Could not fetch profile dir to read playerConfig" warning on the title screen.

- **Ctrl+O and practice mode, for good.** Etterna's own Ctrl+O (its practice-mode switch) is undone at once whenever it gets past VSRG Hub's options key, however short the key press, and its "Practice Mode On" message is hidden. Ctrl+O only opens and closes the options / menu.

- **Ctrl+O never turns practice mode on by itself any more.** On song select Ctrl+O is VSRG Hub's options / menu in every look; Etterna's own Ctrl+O (its practice-mode switch) could sometimes get through as well. Practice mode stays where you set it (the Practice mod, or the menu's row).

- **Lane flash on misses is off by default.** Etterna's combo break highlight (a column lit in the judgment's colour on a Bad or a Miss) no longer shows unless you turn it on: "Lane flash on misses" in the options (osu! and Quaver looks) or the Ctrl+O menu (Til' Death and Rebirth). It works in every look.

- **osu! and Quaver looks: the full lane cover.** Off, sudden or hidden, with its height, opacity and colour (12 colours), as in Til' Death and Rebirth. Skins with a mania-stage-bottom keep their own art as a fourth choice, "Skin". Covers you set before stay as they were.
- **A new Customize gameplay panel in the osu! and Quaver looks**, each in its look's own style (osu!'s settings, Quaver's options dialog): five tabs (Notefield, Notes, Receptors, Lane cover, HUD), a slider with - / + for every value, the lane cover's modes and colour swatches, and every HUD part with a switch. Picking a part on the screen opens its tab; the header drags the panel out of a wide notefield's way.

- **Til' Death and Rebirth: lane cover in Customize Gameplay.** Off, sudden (over the far end of the lanes) or hidden (over the receptors), with its height, opacity and colour (12 colours, with a swatch). It is kept per key mode and, while it is on, it replaces the theme's own lane cover. It covers the whole notefield, also with Rebirth's notefield width and column spacing.
- **Rebirth's panel has two tabs**, Noteskin and Lane cover, so it stays small and out of the way.

- **Til' Death: Customize Gameplay with a panel**, in Til' Death's own colours. The notefield (position, hit position, width, height, column spacing) has - / + buttons, and every part Til' Death lets you move is listed: click Move / Size / Spacing / Turn on a part, then drag it or use the arrow keys (Backspace resets it, right click lets go). No more letter keys to remember or "hold R" (which made the pick blink); Til' Death's key list and the yellow hint line are gone.
- **Til' Death and Rebirth get the noteskin settings of the osu! and Quaver looks**: note spacing, note size, receptor offset / size / width / height, stage hint offset / height and LN tail height / offset, the same values per noteskin in every look. Rebirth keeps its own menu for its parts and the notefield; the new rows sit at the top left, clear of the play's parts and of Rebirth's menu. The panel can be dragged by its title and folded with a click on it, and it starts below Etterna's frame rate display when that is on.
- In these two themes the stage hint is also one line across the whole stage.

- **New name: VSRG Hub.** The title screen, the looks ("VSRG Hub osu!" / "VSRG Hub Quaver"), the program (VSRGHub/vsrghub.exe) and this page. Coming from TriWheel, the first launch moves over your converted song library (nothing is converted again), your settings, Customize gameplay layout and keybinds, and your Full LN / Inverse charts.
- **Only Etterna is needed.** osu!, Quaver and Qwilight are optional: whichever you have adds its songs and skins, and the ones you don't have are simply left out (also when Melty passes an empty folder for them).

- **Customize gameplay: Note size, Stage hint offset and Stage hint height** (kept per noteskin, 4K and 7K apart). Note size draws the notes, hold heads, bodies and ends bigger or smaller than their column. Stage hint offset moves the skin's hit line (and osu!'s judgement line) up or down from the hit position, and Stage hint height makes it taller or thinner; for skins without receptors, whose only hit marker is the stage hint.
- **The stage hint is one picture across the whole stage**, as osu! and Quaver draw it. It used to be drawn once per column, so skins with gaps between columns or columns of different widths (R Skin - AZUSA soo-, for one) showed a broken line with brighter overlaps.

- **Very long LNs no longer show a cut in the middle.** Etterna draws a stretched hold body from its far end in batches and leaves out one step between batches, so holds longer than about five screens showed a thin cut across the body. Skins whose hold body is the same all the way down (the tall "Percy" bodies TriWheel cuts a plain slice from, solid bodies...) now repeat their body instead of stretching it: it looks the same, and repeated bodies are drawn from the edge of the screen, so the cut never reaches it. Skins whose body really changes along its length still stretch it, as osu! does.

- **Customize gameplay: Column spacing and Note spacing.** "Column width" is now called **Column spacing**: the gap between the columns (receptors and notes move together, the notes keep their size). The new **Note spacing** spreads only the notes and long notes further apart (or closer) than the receptors, for skins whose notes don't line up with their receptors; +0 keeps them together. Both are kept per noteskin, for 4K and 7K separately.

- **Failing ends the play at once.** The fail used to fade out over two seconds while the song kept being judged, so the misses and hits in that fade counted towards the results. Now the screen cuts to black the moment you fail, and the results show the accuracy and counts you died with (osu! and Quaver looks).
- **Pause opens instantly.** The pause menu's pictures are loaded when the song starts instead of when Esc is pressed, so the game no longer hitches for a moment before pausing.
- **No coloured lines beside long notes.** Hold bodies and ends from osu! and Quaver skins whose image sizes aren't powers of two (THE SKIN's 7K, for one) are copied at a power-of-two size, and notes, hold heads and keys are drawn from half a texel inside their edges, so no line of leftover texture memory shows along their sides.
- **Map preview: long notes come in whole.** Notes now come in from the very top of the preview box (behind a short fade) instead of appearing partway down with their hold ends still growing.

- **No more 1-pixel lines around skin pictures.** Etterna stores a picture whose size isn't a power of two inside a bigger texture and leaves the rest of that texture as it was in memory; drawn up to its very edge, the picture picked up a line of random coloured dots or a faint frame along its sides (very visible around the score, combo and accuracy digits on the results screen). Skin pictures are now drawn from half a texel inside their edges: the digits, judgments, rank, song panels, health bar, cursor, mod icons and the pause menu's art, in the osu! and Quaver looks (and the pause menu in every look).

  - View Map: clicking anywhere on the graph jumps there (before, anything past the middle sent the song back to the middle). The osu! look's Map Preview too.

  - Etterna's own "Customize Gameplay" player option now opens the editor for the next song (once).

  - The accuracy's % is no longer cut off (skins whose % is wider than their digits, like Low Zenith).
  - Without skin art, the back / mode / mods / random / options buttons are flat labels on the bottom bar that light up under the mouse (F1 / F2 / F3 shown, F2 is random).

- Switching looks keeps your key mode, the selected chart and your noteskin, and the osu! and Quaver looks open straight on song select.

- Quaver skins look the way they do in Quaver:
  - Skins downloaded from the Steam Workshop are now available as noteskins too, not only the ones in Quaver's Skins folder.
  - Notes coloured by beat snap, from separate pictures or from a sprite sheet (before, skins that use a sheet were left out).
  - Notes and receptors turned per column, the gap between columns (NotePadding) and note height (WidthForNoteHeightScale).
  - Settings a skin leaves out come from its DefaultSkin (Bar, Arrow or Circle), as in Quaver.
  - Hold ends are centred on the hold's end with the body under them, so long notes no longer show a gap.
  - Receptors are drawn in front of the notes when the skin asks for it.
  - Hit lighting, hold lighting and column lighting.

- Fixed: with an osu! skin that has both 4K and 7K notes, the columns took the other key mode's width, so notes and keys overlapped (or had gaps). Each mode now uses its own column width.

- Options: on the main menu the Notes rows show your saved noteskins, and a noteskin picked there (or for the other key mode) is the one you play with.
- Esc closes only the list you're in, not the options panel behind it.

- Fixed: the menus on song select (Group by, Sort by, Mode, the options panel and its lists) opened invisibly, and the game's cursor stayed in the corner. Clicking the buttons of a dialog (like the exit question) works again.
- Alt + mouse wheel changes the volume on song select before the wheel moves.
- Customize gameplay: click a part to pick it, then drag it or use the mouse wheel; the wheel only sizes the picked part, right click lets go, and the part under the mouse is outlined.
- osu! look: "Map Preview" in the "Local Ranking" box shows the chart scrolling with the song, the difficulty graph to click and Tab to play from there, like Quaver's View Map. Notes now stay inside the preview box in both looks, and the preview covers the whole song.
- Clicking one of your local scores (osu! look) opens its results.
- Keys (4K / 7K) in the options opens a small list instead of switching on a click.
- Searching updates each pack's song count to the songs that match.
- osu! results: the hit art beside each count is sized to fit, and counts no longer use the skin's "x" glyph (some skins draw it as "Score").
- Hold ends: the skin's end image now sits inside the hold, turned the way osu! (or Quaver) turns it, so round skins end their long notes with a round cap. Skins without a tail image use the head image, as osu! does.
- Quaver skins now also give 4K noteskins (sized by their ColumnSize).
- Difficulties of one map set are one song again when their timing lines differ only slightly (Til' Death and the other looks show them as one song with its charts).
- Dan Overlay keeps working in the osu! and Quaver looks.
- Til' Death: the chart preview is smaller; Customize Gameplay reminds you that R + Up / Down moves the hit position. Player options' noteskin preview shows 7 columns in 7K, and the osu! OD row has its name.

- Customize gameplay (Options > Customize gameplay, or Etterna's Customize Gameplay option): the chart plays on autoplay with an editor over it, for 4K and 7K separately. Drag any part (judgment, combo, score, accuracy, health bar, mods, hit error bar, time) to move it, mouse wheel to resize; drag the notefield for its position and hit position. Also notefield size, column width, receptor offset and size, and Etterna's extra parts (error bar, progress bar, judgment counter, mean, NPS, pace).
- Results show Etterna's hit-offset plot in both looks: every hit and miss across the chart, judge windows, mean / SD / largest / combo breaks per hand, a column filter (click or 1-7, H for hands) to see which finger missed where, Wife% rescored from J4 to Justice, and the score so far when you hover.
- Quaver's Full LN and Inverse mods (osu!lazer's Invert), converted the way Quaver does it. The converted chart is written once to Songs/TriWheel Mods and has its own MSD and scores.
- Judge or osu! OD: pick Etterna's judge (J4 to Justice) or osu!'s OD 0-10, in the options and Etterna's Player Options; using one turns the other off.
- Group by Pattern (Stream, Jumpstream, Handstream, Stamina, JackSpeed, Chordjack, Technical); a chart can be in more than one.
- Quaver View Map: the graph shows how hard each part is on the MSD scale with a line following the song; click it to jump there; Tab plays the chart from that point. The preview now covers the whole song there.
- Alt + mouse wheel changes the volume on every screen; right click on an empty part of song select pauses the preview.
- 4K / 7K from a menu: the Keys row in the options and the mode button / MODE dropdown.
- 7K bar skins draw their stage hint line at the hit position; other skins keep their 7K keys.
- osu! look: the song wheel, buttons and panels are drawn by TriWheel instead of skin art with osu!-only text; the skin still gives the backgrounds, main menu background, mod icons and gameplay. A changed interface skin applies with Enter or the Apply button.
- Fixed: arrow keys and the mouse wheel move the Quaver song list again.
- Fixed: buttons in dialogs (like the exit question) can be clicked again.

- Fixed: long notes were drawn wrong with many osu! skins: when Etterna couldn't load the skin's long-note body, the note image was repeated along the hold. TriWheel now converts the skin's own body so Etterna can load it and stretches it over the hold, as osu! does.
- Fixed: in downscroll the long-note head and end cap were swapped (the head showed at the top of the hold). Heads now sit at the start, end caps at the end, for osu! and Quaver skins, in 4K and 7K.
- Faster start: the converted long-note bodies are kept and only redone when the skin's file changes.
- Quaver look: View Map shows the chart scrolling inside its box (it spilled out before), and difficulty numbers use Quaver's own colours (cyan, green, light blue, yellow, red, pink, violet, grey-white from 50).
- Quaver look: the Mode drop-down switches between 4 and 7 keys without leaving the theme, and you land back on song select.
- osu! look: the mode button opens osu!'s mode list (osu!mania 4K / 7K) instead of Etterna's game screen.
- osu! and Quaver looks: start typing anywhere on song select to search, as in osu! and Quaver.
- osu! look: with skins whose bottom-bar art covers the whole screen (osu!faithful), the top bar (Group, Sort, search) is no longer hidden.
- Fixed: the 7K noteskin you picked could fall back to Etterna's default after going back to the main menu.
- Fixed: Ctrl+O no longer leaves practice mode switched on, and Enter plays the selected song again after using the options.
- The selected row in the options panel is easier to see.
